verdict.rationale: smolagents ships CLI utilities (`smolagent`, `webagent`) that let users run agents 'without writing boilerplate code,' implying natural-language task input, and its core agent design (CodeAgent/ToolCallingAgent) is built around taking a task and converting it to actions. However, no evidence explicitly shows a natural-language command example or interactive prompt syntax being used end-to-end. Missing for 10: an explicit example of a natural-language command/prompt driving the CLI or agent.run(), and independent confirmation that non-technical users can operate it without code.
